build_order: shared config (externalized boundaries, reorder window, buffer capacities, logging/export literals)
domain: Telemetry Sample, Ingress Packet, Sensor Metric Boundary, validation status, events
application: validation use case, reorder/history use case, audit port
infrastructure: append-only history repository adapter, audit adapter, event broadcast adapter
database step: migrations (history, event revisions, audit_trail)
interface: reactive ingress endpoint, correlation WebFilter

module_layout.integration: In-process: Ingestion & Validation publishes TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed through a bounded backpressure-aware event stream port; History consumes it (customer-supplier). History broadcasts TelemetrySampleBackfilled, TelemetryRevisionAppended, TelemetryWindowBuffered through a published-language stream port to downstream analytics (PulseStream Engine), declared as an out-of-process boundary with no consumer unit in this service. Delivery posture: at-least-once inbound; History owns dedup identity (device_id, metric, t_device) so retries never append duplicate revisions.

drivers: embedded in-process substitute for boot/tests only
persistence.storage_paradigm: Relational, append-only time-ordered store owned by Telemetry Stream Processing & History; Ingestion & Validation owns no persistent data (boundary definitions are configuration).
persistence.data_model: Raw sample history keyed by (device, metric, t_device) with Event Revision records appended for corrections/backfills (never updated or deleted); t_ingress stored but never used for ordering; validation status stored per sample (VALIDATION_FAILED payloads retained); append-only audit_trail.
persistence.queries: Insert-only writes; range reads ordered by t_device per device/metric; revision lookup by sample identity; windowed reads for buffering.
persistence.migration_plan: Expand-only versioned migrations packaged with the artifact; one unit per table group; portable column types.
persistence.backup_recovery: History is the source of truth: periodic snapshots plus point-in-time recovery of the append-only store; replay of revisions rebuilds derived views.
open_questions: Delivery posture and dedup identity confirmation (assumed at-least-once; identity device+metric+t_device owned by History)
Handling of packets later than the 60-second window (assumed Event Revision)
Boundaries for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke (left unbounded)

observability.correlation_key: requestId (generated or adopted at the ingress edge; carried in Reactor Context and as a field of every audit record; propagated to log lines via context-propagation)

audit_trail.sink: append-only audit_trail table via an audit port and infrastructure adapter

observability.metric_tag_policy: bounded enumerations only; never deviceId or other unbounded ids

logs.sink: local append-only rolling JSON-lines file declared in configuration, shipped by the platform (Filebeat/Elastic Agent class)
logs.dependency: none at runtime; boot gate passes with the log-management tool absent

metrics.mechanism: Micrometer registry via actuator; no scrape endpoint or push exporter unless named by the description

risks: Unspecified delivery posture/dedup identity may cause duplicate revisions; mitigated by natural-identity dedup in History
Unbounded buffers under burst: all buffers/sinks bounded with config-driven capacities and overflow duty
Blocking I/O on event-loop threads violates the zero-blocking invariant
Fan-out sink autoCancel would kill ingestion on subscriber disconnect; use non-autocancel buffered sink
Late packets beyond 60s unspecified; treated as Event Revision
Log correlation lost across reactive hops without context-propagation
Unbounded metric tag cardinality from device ids
